name: @dryanovski/gamefoo
description: A lightweight 2D game engine with behavior-based component system

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --sourcemap=external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run build
